title: 1Password account audit-stream and membership state
description: Account state read from 1Password's documented APIs (#2968). org_id and audit_events_enabled come from the Events API introspect endpoint (GET /api/v2/auth/introspect); the member counts come from the Users API (GET /v1/accounts/{account}/users). v1's two_factor_required, minimum_password_length and domain_restrictions_enabled are gone: no documented 1Password API reports them.

org_id.description: The account's UUID, as the Events API introspect response's account_uuid reports it.

audit_events_enabled.description: True when the Events Reporting integration whose token the connector holds is authorized for audit events (introspect features include auditevents). False means the account's audit-event stream does not reach this deployment through that integration; another integration on the account may still read it.

active_members.description: Users the Users API reports with state ACTIVE.

suspended_members.description: Users the Users API reports with state SUSPENDED. Users in any other state (the API omits state for them, e.g. pending confirmation) are in neither count.
